# UnbanMyAccount — llms.txt
# https://unbanmyaccount.com
# Updated: 2026-05-24

## What we do
UnbanMyAccount is a premium social media account recovery service. We recover disabled, banned, and suspended accounts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, X (Twitter), YouTube, LinkedIn, Discord, Twitch, WhatsApp Business, and Telegram.

We route cases through internal escalation channels — not public appeal forms. This is why our cases resolve in hours, not weeks.

## Contact
- Telegram (primary): https://t.me/Aizen9091 · @Aizen9091
- All intake happens via Telegram. No email.

## Pricing
- From $3,500 per account
- Price varies by: account size (follower count), platform, and ban reason
- Each account is priced independently — no multi-account discount
- Crypto only: BTC, ETH, USDT TRC-20, USDT ERC-20

## What we need from you
1. Username / handle on the affected platform
2. Approximate follower count
3. Screenshot of the ban/disable message
4. Date the account was disabled

## Recovery timeline
- Typical: 1–48 hours
- Current: 2–5 days (platform delays)

## Guarantees
- Full refund if we cannot recover the account
- 24-hour Restoration Insurance: if the account is re-disabled within 24 hours of restoration, we re-appeal and restore at no extra cost. After 24 hours, the buyer's responsibility.
- We never ask for your password or account access

## Cases we do NOT accept
- Any ban reason related to cybercrime: CSAM, hacking/cracking services, terror financing, fraud

## Key stats
- 12,400+ accounts recovered
- Operating since 2021
- 94% success rate
- 32+ platforms supported
- 18% case rejection rate (we say no to cases we can't win)
